question.value: Does the proto-brown dwarf Mayrit 1701117 host a pseudo-disc, and which formation model (core collapse, disc fragmentation, circum-binary disc) reproduces its CO kinematics?

evidence.quote: We present the observational evidence of a pseudo-disc around the proto-brown dwarf Mayrit 1701117, the driving source of the large-scale HH 1165 jet.
Observations with ALMA were carried out in May, 2016 (PID: 2016.1.01453.S; PI: Riaz).

analysis_steps.goal: Measure continuum source size, position and flux

method.value: Fit elliptical Gaussians to the 1.37 mm continuum image

evidence.quote: We have used the CASA tasks *uvmodelfit* and *imfit* to measure the source size, peak position and the continuum flux by fitting one or more elliptical Gaussian components on the image.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive dust and total mass from the continuum

method.value: Optically thin dust mass with Planck function at Tdust

evidence.quote: Assuming that the dust emission at 1.37 mm is optically thin, the dust continuum mass can be calculated from the millimeter flux density as

assumptions.value: kappa = 0.1 (nu/1e12)^beta cm2/g, beta = 1, Tdust = 10 K, gas-to-dust 100, d = 410 pc

evidence.quote: Assuming the dust and gas temperature of 10 K, M$_{dust}$ = 0.21$\pm$0.1 M$_{Jup}$.

validation.value: Compared with SCUBA-2 mass; difference attributed to beam contamination

evidence.quote: The much larger beam size can result in severe contamination from the surrounding medium and enhance the observed emission.

analysis_steps.goal: Channel, moment maps and PVDs of CO and other lines

method.value: Moment 0/1/2 maps and image-space PVDs along disc axis (PA 55 deg) and jet axis

evidence.quote: Figure [6](#pvd-co) shows the CO line PVDs created by making a cut along the disc axis (left panel) and the jet axis (right panel).

analysis_steps.goal: Fit CO spectrum and PVD with physical models

method.value: Input density, temperature, velocity structure from each model into MOLLIE non-LTE radiative transfer; vary abundance profile and line width; convolve with 0.4 arcsec beam; compare spectrum and PVD offsets

evidence.quote: is used as an input to the 3D non-LTE radiative transfer code MOLLIE (Keto et al. 2004). We generate synthetic CO spectra for different radial profiles of the molecular abundance.

key_parameters.value: inclination varied; best CC fit 60-70 deg

evidence.quote: The best-fit was obtained for a close to edge-on inclination of 60$\ensuremath{^\circ}$-70$\ensuremath{^\circ}$.

assumptions.value: Dust-to-gas ratio fixed at 0.01 in simulations

evidence.quote: In these simulations, the dust-to-gas ratio is fixed to 0.01

fitting.value: Reduced chi-squared minimisation over synthetic spectra

evidence.quote: For each synthetic spectrum, a reduced-$\chi^{2}$ value is computed to determine the goodness of fit.

validation.value: Compare model PVD peak positions and velocities with observed PVD

evidence.quote: we produced a PVD for a cut along the disc axis (55$\ensuremath{^\circ}$), and compared the position and velocity offsets in the model and observed PVDs.

method.value: Match velocity offset in CC snapshots at different ages; compare H2 column density from CO modelling and continuum

evidence.quote: We checked for a match with the observed velocity offset using the CC simulation data at different evolutionary stages.

findings_qualitative.value: Keplerian-only discs of 0.35 Msun single or binary fit CO spectrum and PVD poorly

evidence.quote: a purely Keplerian disc model cannot re-produce the observed morphology

findings_qualitative.value: No continuum or line emission detected from the shocked knots

evidence.quote: No continuum or line emission is detected at a $\geq$2-$\sigma$ level for any of the shocked regions.

claims.hypothesis: M1701117 hosts a pseudo-disc consistent with core-collapse brown dwarf formation
claims.experiment: CO PVD and spectrum modelled with MOLLIE using CC simulation
claims.result: Reduced chi2 1.1; reproduces ±2 km/s spread and size
claims.finding: Pseudo-disc plus unresolved Keplerian disc explain the kinematics; age 30,000-40,000 yr

evidence.quote: The observed morphology, velocity structure, and the physical dimensions of the pseudo-disc are consistent with the predictions from the core collapse simulations for brown dwarf formation.

claims.hypothesis: Disc fragmentation or Keplerian circum-binary disc could explain the observations
claims.experiment: Same fitting with DF and SK350/CB SPH models
claims.finding: These models fit worse than CC

evidence.quote: The DF model can re-produce the brightness asymmetry in the observations, but the shapes of the lobes are a poor fit.

claims.hypothesis: CO is depleted in the pseudo-disc
claims.experiment: Compare H2 column from CO modelling and from continuum

evidence.quote: indicates that only $\sim$2% of the CO is depleted from the gas phase

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Disc fragmentation and single/circum-binary Keplerian disc models rejected or disfavoured by poorer fits

evidence.quote: The poor model fits in Fig. [19](#SK350-CB-fit) show that the structure of a 20 M$_{Jup}$ disc around a 0.35 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ single/binary star is inconsistent

limitations_admitted.value: H2CO and N2D+ detections are weak (~2-3 sigma), so interpretation is speculative

evidence.quote: the H$_{2}$CO and N$_{2}$D$^{+}$ detection is quite weak ($\sim$2-3$\sigma$) in M1701117, therefore we can only speculate

limitations_admitted.value: Independent gas mass cannot be derived from the CC fit

evidence.quote: we are unable to obtain an independent estimate on the gas mass derived from the CC model fit.

referee_caveats_inferred: Only one DF simulation was tested, so the comparison between formation scenarios is not a fair test
Model comparison rests on one spectrum with ~8-9 sigma peak and few PVD peak positions; degeneracies and parameter uncertainties are not explored
Model fit uncertainty on age and inclination are not quantified
Binary scenario not excluded at <0.1 arcsec
